title: XunZi, an AI biologist, reveals disease-modifying targets
final_rationale: The abstract describes an AI biologist that integrates logical reasoning and multimodal data fusion to autonomously generate de novo therapeutic target hypotheses. It also reports large-scale training on 24.4 million publications and 613.6 TB of multisource data, supporting foundation-model evidence.
